procedure.method: Independent fresh-session craft review restricted to the exact listed pins. Read the full packet, literal case, rules, rubric, compact addendum/method and adapter schema; verified the listed byte pins and read all five native-evidence manifests without following their embedded paths. The packet supplies zero source assets and zero protected-layout manifests, so no source image opens or protected-layout reads apply. Actually opened and visually inspected the fifteen exact poster PNGs with tools.view_image(detail:'original'), emitted their images, sequentially in packet order M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4, M5 in that same three-view order. All fifteen completed before the first copy-reading/transcription stage, any judgment or score. Subsequently retained all sixty first raw readings in packet copy order, then opened each of M1, M3 and M4 native once more to resolve the date/time range ambiguities; those exact pinned revisits are retained per affected entry, and first reads were not changed. Checked actual PNG dimensions and RGB opacity read-only. Judgments use visible pixels at the supplied scales, not maker intent. No images were produced or edited, no peer or producer/planner records or unlisted embedded paths were read, and no agents were spawned, forked or resumed. No tool-event/session ID is invented; session_id remains null.
